section: Vapour pressure of solutions of liquids in liquids: Consider a binary solution of two volatile liquids A_1 and A_2. When the solution is placed in a closed container, both the liquids vaporize. Eventually an equilibrium is established between vapor and liquid phases. Both the components are present in the vapour phase. The partial pressure of the components are related to their mole fractions in the solution. This realationship is given by Raoult's law.
